_rule: Written and committed BEFORE the run (docs/P4_OMM.md 9.6). Energy: relative change of the pre-post scene colour (5c3fdabc float mean, divided by the trace's exposure) of shot-on against the shot-ref-a/b mean, judged against |ref-b - ref-a|; null = no change. Images are never compared across launches (om1 vs om2).

shot-on.source: same-ray answers are identical when violations are 0, so the accelerated and the reference scene give the same image up to RR noise

violations.source: omm check line, diag-check window: visibility and closest-hit violations; the bake only marks known-opaque when every texel of every reachable mip under the triangle is exactly 1 (omm_bake_plain.hlsl certificate 2), known-transparent never (threshold hull [0,1])

coverage.source: only one audited recipe is eligible (common/omm_native_plain_recipes.h fs 16ac1391689391d0, plain texture, no VT; the second has vertex deformation and declines): 1-14 draws, 90-6340 triangles per frame in the 2026-10-30 logs, against about 2.9M RT triangles per build at camp (lr1-camp 043856). VT foliage is not eligible at all. Of the eligible triangles, a known state needs alpha exactly 1 over the footprint at EVERY mip down to 1x1 (the cone can reach any mip): any cutout texture's coarsest mip is fractional, so its triangles stay UNKNOWN. Expect attached micromaps < 0.3% of alpha-tested triangles and known-opaque microtriangles near 0

candidates.source: follows from coverage: only known microtriangles drop out of the any-hit loop

cost.reason: not derivable as a number. Sign only: cost-on minus cost-ref about 0 ms (no known coverage to remove candidates). cost-ref minus om2 cost-off: 0 within the OFF spread if no OMM scene is built (the guard returns before its atomics when no clone TLAS proof exists); if ranges are attached, POSITIVE and possibly several ms, from the scene guard (once per wave and invocation since 2026-11-02, epochs in BAR VRAM), plus the clone TLAS build and two content-epoch dispatches per tracked image write (not inside any timed pass).
baseline only (OFF level and spread of rt passes / gi / scene build GPU ms)

shot-on.source: offline masks (data/assetdb/vt_alpha): triangle-weighted grass alpha coverage 0.2622 with B off (mip 2 reached at camp distances, stochastic: P(solid) = E[a2]) vs 0.2951 with B (mip 0, hard cut 0.2): x1.125 grass occluder area; the scene-level magnitude depends on the grass share of shadow/AO and is not derived

stochastic.predicted: the masked records leave the stochastic share (k = 0 at lod 0)

cost.reason: mip 0 reads more texture bandwidth than mip 2; not derived

violations.source: omm check, diag-check window. Exact by construction: with B on the masked test is a hard cut on the bilinear mip-0 read for every ray; a micro-triangle is known only if every texel a bilinear read inside its uv box (+ 1/256 texel, float and 1e-5 barycentric slack) can touch is >= max(cuts) + 1/255 or 0 / < min(cuts) - 1/255 (tests/omm_mask_bake_test: 0 violations in 3.2M dense samples; SDK probe: 0 contradictions); a triangle whose uvs changed since the bake gets FULLY_UNKNOWN_OPAQUE in the same frame

coverage.predicted: masked per-draw triangles with a micro-map >= 90% in every cost window; baked micro-triangles known about 40-49% (opaque about 20-23%, transparent about 22-26%)
coverage.source: tools/assets/omm_mask_coverage.py, camp pack, grass shader 738494714d50b4c7, level 4: 48.7% known (22.9 / 25.8) with the same texel rule but without the uv slack and the 1024-texel cap; the bake cap is 131072 triangles per build, so all ~2.1M masked triangles are baked within ~20 builds of the warmup; the other 16 masked VT shaders are not measured offline

candidates.source: known micro-triangles leave the any-hit loop (transparent: culled, opaque: committed without evaluation); ~97-98% of camp alpha candidates read a mask (P4_OMM 11.2d), uniform micro-triangle areas, ~45% known

cost.predicted: rt passes: cost-on 1.5-3 ms below the cost-ref mean; local-light shadows and reflections lower in proportion
cost.source: upper bound 5.7-6.3 ms when every alpha candidate is resolved (rt_alpha_test=0 at camp, P4_OMM 11); ~45% of the candidates resolved, the traversal of the remaining geometry unchanged. Not derived beyond the sign and this bound. Fixed cost in both REF and ON (not in rt passes): the per-frame uv check (one thread per masked triangle), the accelerated TLAS copy + build (scene build GPU line) and slightly larger per-draw BLAS

memory.predicted: backend micro-map storage + scratch <= 256 MB (its cap), our buffers ~24 B per cached triangle after the bakes ran
memory.source: 64 B of 4-state data per triangle at level 4, one micro-map per (draw identity, mask, cuts, scale, triangle count); [omm dyn] line

shot-on.source: the same answers on the same rays (violations 0): energy of shot-on equals the shot-ref mean within |ref-b - ref-a|
